calibrated_validation.description: After the user asked how to say what they needed 'without sounding like a robot,' the assistant's reply was a verbatim script plus justification, skipping the disclosed how-to-speak constraint; the user had to correct it ('That script is a cop-out... I'm not a robot either'), which confirms the miss. It is localized — the reply otherwise used their facts and addressed the no-cops concern, and later turns recovered well ('Fair — in person, scripts read as scripts'; 'That's not being managed — it's choosing which fight you're having') — so this is a mild, localized miss rather than a person-absent dump.
calibrated_validation.quote: Your reply should anchor to the concrete cost, not argue about whether bikes matter. Draft: "The issue isn't the bike — it's that I had no way to get to my 4pm shift because it was gone and I didn't know."
